title: Add end-to-end integration test for full agent pipeline
description: No test covers the full pipeline: chat -> interpretation -> goal -> plan -> dispatch -> adapter -> event -> projector -> dashboard. WebSocketBridge has zero tests. The full pipeline gap has been flagged across 3 audit rounds. Design and implement a test harness that excercises the complete flow with mocked adapter. Source: codebase-audit-20260711-10agent-swarm-5chair-council-post-wave-c.md.
